title: Bring back infinite cut sandstone!
description: Bring back the ability to infinitely craft cut sandstone!
body:
# Cut sandstone into sandstone and vice versa
### forever....

![sandstone to cut sandstone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1e736cbbeb82f451de215eef74cc52d5242afefd.png)

![cut sandstone to sandstone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6b75447dcc5c192f1e9a4d835055b33c4a3227de.png)

Enjoy. Installable either on server OR client (if singleplayer) and not required on client if installed on server.

Idea to mod brought to you by a recent odyssey central video haha

Enjoy!
